description.value: Adelicia's is a family-rooted Mexican restaurant in Langley, BC, drawing on the owners' family food heritage from Mexico to serve homemade dishes ranging from sopes and flautas to carne asada and chile relleno. The full bar program — signature Bulldogs, house margaritas, and a long cocktail list — sets it apart from typical takeout spots. Sitting on Fraser Hwy, it offers dine-in, online ordering via DoorDash and Uber Eats, weekend brunch, and a kids menu, making it a practical and satisfying stop for cyclists on a long route day.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 48m; stands (2 spaces) at 60m; stands (4 spaces) at 69m. Total: 8 spaces.
